6a757a2f478c184bd220c458 description:
Oi, operator, over here. Got a business problem and you're gonna fix it. My couriers keep hauling delicate merchandise in whatever rag they scrounged up, and half of it arrives as garbage. You know what that does to margins? I do. I look at the numbers every night and I want to strangle somebody.

Now everyone's yapping about this fancy ship out in the ice. Some outfit up there kits their people out properly, and I mean properly. Go have a look, and if their boys are carrying decent bags, take them off them. Bring me what you find and we'll see if it holds up.
6a757a2f478c184bd220c458 startedMessageT: Five decent bags, merc. Off their backs, not out of some bin.
6a757a2f478c184bd220c458 successMessageT: Well would you look at that. Stitching like a bank vault, and not a scratch on the frame. My couriers get these, my breakage goes away, my numbers go up. You did alright, merc. Come see me, I'll cut you in on one of them.
6a757a2f478c184bd220c458 failMessageText: No bags, no fix. My couriers keep breaking my merchandise and I keep losing money. Cheers for nothing.
6a757a2f478c184bd220c461 description:
The bags work. My guys ran two weeks on them and nothing came back broken, not one crate. You know how long it has been since I could say that about anything?

So do not stop now. I want a proper stock of them, not a handful. Go back to that boat and strip every one you can find. And the big framed ones, those are what I really want, so keep your eyes open. Do it and I will put one aside for you personally.
6a757a2f478c184bd220c461 startedMessageT: Eight more, and the framed ones if you can get them. Fresh off the ship, merc.
6a757a2f478c184bd220c461 successMessageT: Now that is a supply line. Bags for every courier and spares in the back room. Business is business, merc, and you just made mine a lot smoother. That big pack I mentioned, it's yours, come and get it.
6a757a2f478c184bd220c461 failMessageText: Nothing came back. My supply line stays a joke, then.
